title: 10-second short: two worlds merge
about: A 10 s short in four shots: the question in the drawn world, the statement in the void with a word flying through the lens, the answer shown on a split-screen monitor that merges, the sign-off on the generated stage. Hook: universe warp + braam on frame 0. Tested by Sonnet 5.5.
needs: the voxel-starter assets (vm assets reuse); songs are NOT included (bring your own, see score.sh)
